name: joomjoo
description: Payments for AI agents. Your agent gets its own card with a limit you set, clears the bank's 3DS check itself, and checks out in its own browser.

interface.longDescription: Give your agent its own payment card with a limit you set. Joomjoo mints a single-use card at the final review, clears the bank's 3DS check itself, and checks out in its own browser. Two modes: Asks you first, where every purchase waits for your yes, and Buys on its own, never past a card's limit. This plugin teaches the agent the six Joomjoo tools and the API; you bring your own API key from app.joomjoo.com.
